scene.starting.tracks: Someone didn't bother hiding their tracks
scene.starting.help_search: Don't just stand there, Epson! Help me look for clues!

scene.forestc2.who_put: So then! Tell me, who put you in there?

scene.foresttree.backwards_all_along: Backwards feet!? Epson, we've been walking the wrong way from the start!

scene.foresttree.no_help: I don't see how that would help, Epson...
